analysis_period.fiscal_year_basis: Calendar year (Jan-Dec); opening snapshot derived from immediately preceding fiscal year-end (2024-12-01); closing snapshot from current fiscal year-end (2025-12-01)
analysis_period.revenue_basis: Invoice transaction date (invoice_date) used as primary period-assignment basis for all as-reported revenue metrics including fiscal-year revenue, CAGR, concentration, and customer rankings. Revenue measured at fact_invoice_line grain (line_amount_usd) to avoid double-counting invoice header totals.

customer_concentration.grouping_method: Revenue aggregated at legal customer level (fact_invoice.customer_id). Economic parent/group level also calculated using dim_customer.parent_customer_id; where parent_customer_id is null, customer_id is used as own group. Minimal difference observed between the two levels, indicating limited parent-child consolidation impact.
customer_concentration.reconciliation_note: Customer-level and economic-group-level total revenue both equal $42,730,073.29. Top-10 differs slightly (71.30% vs 72.25%) due to parent consolidation affecting rank 10 boundary.

arr_bridge.methodology: Monthly ARR movements derived from fact_subscription_month using LAG window function partitioned by customer_id ordered by snapshot_month. New logo: customer's first-ever positive ARR month (first_active_month = snapshot_month). Reactivation: customer with prior positive ARR history returning after zero. Expansion: ARR increase for already-active customer. Contraction: ARR decrease for customer remaining active. Churn: transition from positive to zero ARR. FY2025 movements aggregated from 2025-01-01 through 2025-12-01. No reactivation events detected in FY2025.

retention.methodology: Opening cohort: 180 customers with positive ARR at 2024-12-01 snapshot. NRR: ending ARR attributable to opening cohort at 2025-12-01 divided by opening cohort ARR. GRR: retained ARR capped at opening ARR per customer (expansion excluded) divided by opening cohort ARR. Logo churn: customers in opening cohort with zero ARR at 2025-12-01 divided by opening cohort count. Reactivation treatment: no reactivation events detected in FY2025; any customer returning to positive ARR after zero would be classified as reactivation and included in NRR but excluded from GRR expansion benefit. Intra-period churn captured via monthly observations.

recurring_revenue.methodology: Management-tagged recurring: sum of lines where revenue_type = 'Recurring'. Independent restatement: subscription delivery model (delivery_model = 'Subscription') AND product_family != 'Professional Services'. Professional Services lines with One-time delivery model are classified as economically non-recurring regardless of revenue_type tag. $4,675,078.45 of Professional Services revenue is tagged 'Recurring' by management but has One-time delivery model — reclassified as non-recurring in independent restatement. No perpetual-delivery revenue exists in FY2025. No ambiguous revenue identified.

collections_quality.dso_methodology: Method A — Direct invoice-level collection-cycle DSO. The fact_collection.days_outstanding field was validated against DATEDIFF(payment_date, invoice_date) for 20 representative invoices; all values matched exactly, confirming days_outstanding represents the number of days from invoice issuance to payment/settlement. Quarterly DSO calculated as simple average of days_outstanding for all collection records assigned to the quarter by invoice_date. Latest complete quarter used for company-level DSO is 2025-Q4 (avg 47.44 days). FY2025 full-year average across all four quarters reported as 51.55 days. Outstanding invoices (status='Outstanding', 96 records) have no payment_date and are excluded from the settled-invoice average DSO series; their outstanding status is captured separately in AR balance and aging analysis.

dso_historical_trend.note: DSO has increased by 8.18 days from 2023-Q1 to 2025-Q4. The trend shows consistent quarterly increases from 2023-Q1 through 2025-Q3 (peak 54.50 days), with a moderation in 2025-Q4 (47.44 days). The management claim of 'stable at approximately 45 days' is not supported by the historical trend; DSO has been rising and exceeded 45 days from 2024-Q1 onward.

cohort_reconciliation.note: Top 3 (3) + Remaining after Top 3 (195) = 198 total customers. No overlap. Populations are mutually exclusive and collectively exhaustive.

collections_quality.weighted_collection_days_methodology: Amount-weighted average of days_outstanding using amount_paid_usd as weight, grouped by invoice quarter. This is a secondary collection-timing metric and is NOT equivalent to the primary DSO series (simple average). Weighted collection days are higher than simple-average DSO in most quarters, indicating larger invoices tend to take longer to collect.
collections_quality.ar_aging_note: AR aging calculated as of 2025-12-31 using DATEDIFF from invoice_date. 96 outstanding invoices totaling $6,236,836.60. No invoices aged beyond 120 days. Top-3 customers account for 85.33% of outstanding AR — highly concentrated.

customer_tenure.population: Top 10 customers by FY2025 invoice-date revenue
customer_tenure.tenure_basis: Tenure calculated as DATEDIFF('2025-12-31', first_order_date) / 365.25 using dim_customer.first_order_date as the earliest supported commercial relationship date.

customer_health.high_severity_note: No High or Critical severity tickets recorded across any year in the dataset. Severity field exists but all observed values are below High/Critical threshold.

metrics.health_observation: Significant CSAT deterioration (-1.66 points) and ticket volume spike (+245% from 2023 to 2025) for the #2 revenue customer. Quantitative health indicators warrant downstream review.

contract_expiry_distribution_reference.note: No authoritative deal close date or diligence horizon was available from the test plan or runtime inputs. Renewal exposure window cannot be anchored. Contract expiration distribution by year is provided for reference only and does not constitute a diligence-horizon renewal exposure calculation.

claim_comparisons.claim_text: No single customer accounts for more than 10% of revenue.
claim_comparisons.note: Independently calculated Top-1 customer concentration is 27.44% (Northwind Retail Group, $11,723,656.87 of $42,730,073.29 FY2025 revenue). This materially exceeds the claimed threshold of 10%.

claim_comparisons.claim_text: Net revenue retention of 118% demonstrates best-in-class expansion.
claim_comparisons.note: Independently calculated NRR using opening cohort at 2024-12-01 (180 customers, $36,075,091.38 ARR) and closing at 2025-12-01 ($36,261,693.31) yields 100.52%. This is materially below the claimed 118.0%.

claim_comparisons.claim_text: 94% of revenue is recurring subscription revenue.
claim_comparisons.note: Independently restated recurring revenue percentage is 87.40% ($37,344,457.53 / $42,730,073.29). Management-tagged recurring is 98.34% but includes $4,675,078.45 of Professional Services revenue with One-time delivery model. The independent restatement excludes Professional Services (One-time delivery) as economically non-recurring regardless of revenue_type tag. Calculated_value reflects the independently tested metric (87.40%), not the management-tagged metric (98.34%).

claim_comparisons.claim_text: Logo churn has remained below 5% annually.
claim_comparisons.note: Independently calculated logo churn: 17 of 180 starting-cohort customers (at 2024-12-01) had zero ARR at 2025-12-01, yielding 9.44% logo churn. This exceeds the claimed threshold of below 5%.

claim_comparisons.claim_text: Adjusted EBITDA of $12.4M represents a 32% margin.
claim_comparisons.note: EBITDA adjustment analysis is outside the Revenue Quality workstream scope. This claim belongs to the EBITDA/Earnings Challenge agent. Revenue basis for margin denominator: FY2025 total revenue = $42,730,073.29 (independently calculated).

claim_comparisons.claim_text: Days sales outstanding is stable at approximately 45 days.
claim_comparisons.note: Latest quarter (2025-Q4) simple-average DSO is 47.44 days. Historical trend shows consistent increase from 39.26 days (2023-Q1) to a peak of 54.50 days (2025-Q3), moderating to 47.44 days in 2025-Q4. DSO has exceeded 45 days in every quarter since 2024-Q1. The claim of 'stable at approximately 45 days' is not supported by the historical trend which shows a net increase of 8.18 days over the analysis period.

claim_comparisons.claim_text: Direct expansion into Europe is the primary growth vector, worth $6M ARR by FY2028.
claim_comparisons.note: FY2028 is a forward projection beyond available structured data (data through FY2025). No geographic revenue breakdown field exists in the discovered schema to independently calculate current EMEA ARR. dim_customer contains country field but no structured EMEA/direct-channel segmentation. The test_plan classifies this as a document-type test. Revenue Quality agent cannot independently calculate a forward ARR projection.

claim_comparisons.claim_text: All customer contracts are freely assignable on a change of control.
claim_comparisons.note: Change-of-control clause analysis requires contract document review. The dim_contract table does not contain a structured change-of-control restriction field. This claim belongs to the Contract Intelligence agent.

claim_comparisons.claim_text: Revenue grew at a 14% CAGR over FY2023-FY2025.
claim_comparisons.note: Independently calculated CAGR from FY2023 ($34,471,835.95) to FY2025 ($42,730,073.29) over 2 periods = 11.34%. This is 2.66pp below the claimed 14.0% CAGR. Revenue measured at invoice-line grain using invoice_date as period basis.

claim_comparisons.claim_text: Top 10 customers have an average tenure of 6 years.
claim_comparisons.note: Independently calculated average tenure for top 10 FY2025 revenue customers is 5.60 years (range: 0.84 to 7.75 years). One top-10 customer (Cascade Foods Holdings, rank 7) has tenure of only 0.84 years (first_order_date 2025-03-01), which materially reduces the average. Excluding this customer, average tenure for remaining 9 would be higher. Tenure basis: dim_customer.first_order_date to 2025-12-31.
MFN clause analysis requires contract document review. The dim_contract table does not contain a structured MFN field. This claim belongs to the Contract Intelligence agent.

Independently calculated GRR using opening cohort at 2024-12-01 (180 customers, $36,075,091.38 ARR). Retained ARR capped at opening ARR per customer (expansion excluded) = $33,606,952.09. GRR = 93.16%. This is 3.84pp below the claimed 97.0%.

metric_evidence.query: SELECT CASE WHEN YEAR(fi.invoice_date) = 2023 THEN 'FY2023' WHEN YEAR(fi.invoice_date) = 2024 THEN 'FY2024' WHEN YEAR(fi.invoice_date) = 2025 THEN 'FY2025' END AS fiscal_year, SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) AS total_revenue_usd, COUNT(DISTINCT fi.invoice_id) AS invoice_count, COUNT(fil.invoice_line_id) AS line_count, COUNT(DISTINCT fi.customer_id) AS customer_count FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil ON fi.invoice_id = fil.invoice_id WHERE YEAR(fi.invoice_date) IN (2023, 2024, 2025) GROUP BY YEAR(fi.invoice_date) ORDER BY fiscal_year
metric_evidence.methodology: Revenue aggregated at invoice-line grain (line_amount_usd) joined to invoice header for invoice_date period assignment. Invoice-date used as authoritative transaction-period basis. No double-counting of invoice header totals.

metric_evidence.query: SELECT fy2023.total_rev AS fy2023_revenue, fy2025.total_rev AS fy2025_revenue, 2 AS num_periods, (POWER(fy2025.total_rev / fy2023.total_rev, 1.0/2.0) - 1) * 100 AS cagr_pct FROM (SELECT SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) AS total_rev FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil ON fi.invoice_id = fil.invoice_id WHERE YEAR(fi.invoice_date) = 2023) fy2023, (SELECT SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) AS total_rev FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil ON fi.invoice_id = fil.invoice_id WHERE YEAR(fi.invoice_date) = 2025) fy2025
metric_evidence.methodology: CAGR = (FY2025_Revenue / FY2023_Revenue)^(1/2) - 1. Calculated entirely in SQL using POWER function. 2 periods between FY2023 and FY2025.

metric_evidence.metric: Customer concentration FY2025 - legal and economic group level
metric_evidence.query: WITH fy2025_rev AS (SELECT fi.customer_id, SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) AS customer_revenue FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil ON fi.invoice_id = fil.invoice_id WHERE YEAR(fi.invoice_date) = 2025 GROUP BY fi.customer_id), total AS (SELECT SUM(customer_revenue) AS total_rev FROM fy2025_rev), ranked AS (SELECT customer_id, customer_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY customer_revenue DESC) AS rev_rank FROM fy2025_rev) SELECT t.total_rev, SUM(CASE WHEN r.rev_rank = 1 THEN r.customer_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS top1_rev, SUM(CASE WHEN r.rev_rank <= 3 THEN r.customer_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS top3_rev, SUM(CASE WHEN r.rev_rank <= 5 THEN r.customer_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS top5_rev, SUM(CASE WHEN r.rev_rank <= 10 THEN r.customer_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS top10_rev, SUM(CASE WHEN r.rev_rank = 1 THEN r.customer_revenue ELSE 0 END) / t.total_rev * 100 AS top1_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN r.rev_rank <= 3 THEN r.customer_revenue ELSE 0 END) / t.total_rev * 100 AS top3_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN r.rev_rank <= 5 THEN r.customer_revenue ELSE 0 END) / t.total_rev * 100 AS top5_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN r.rev_rank <= 10 THEN r.customer_revenue ELSE 0 END) / t.total_rev * 100 AS top10_pct FROM ranked r CROSS JOIN total t GROUP BY t.total_rev
metric_evidence.methodology: Revenue ranked at legal customer level using RANK() window function. Concentration percentages calculated in SQL. Economic group level uses COALESCE(parent_customer_id, customer_id) as group identifier.

metric_evidence.query: WITH monthly_arr AS (SELECT customer_id, snapshot_month, arr_usd, LAG(arr_usd) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY snapshot_month) AS prev_arr FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month), customer_first_active AS (SELECT customer_id, MIN(snapshot_month) AS first_active_month FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month WHERE arr_usd > 0 GROUP BY customer_id), movements AS (SELECT m.customer_id, m.snapshot_month, m.arr_usd, m.prev_arr, cfa.first_active_month, CASE WHEN m.arr_usd > 0 AND (m.prev_arr IS NULL OR m.prev_arr = 0) AND cfa.first_active_month = m.snapshot_month THEN 'new_logo' WHEN m.arr_usd > 0 AND (m.prev_arr IS NULL OR m.prev_arr = 0) AND cfa.first_active_month < m.snapshot_month THEN 'reactivation' WHEN m.arr_usd > m.prev_arr AND m.prev_arr > 0 THEN 'expansion' WHEN m.arr_usd < m.prev_arr AND m.arr_usd > 0 THEN 'contraction' WHEN m.arr_usd = 0 AND m.prev_arr > 0 THEN 'churn' ELSE 'unchanged' END AS movement_type, CASE WHEN m.arr_usd > 0 AND (m.prev_arr IS NULL OR m.prev_arr = 0) AND cfa.first_active_month = m.snapshot_month THEN m.arr_usd WHEN m.arr_usd > 0 AND (m.prev_arr IS NULL OR m.prev_arr = 0) AND cfa.first_active_month < m.snapshot_month THEN m.arr_usd WHEN m.arr_usd > m.prev_arr AND m.prev_arr > 0 THEN m.arr_usd - m.prev_arr WHEN m.arr_usd < m.prev_arr AND m.arr_usd > 0 THEN m.arr_usd - m.prev_arr WHEN m.arr_usd = 0 AND m.prev_arr > 0 THEN -m.prev_arr ELSE 0 END AS arr_movement FROM monthly_arr m LEFT JOIN customer_first_active cfa ON m.customer_id = cfa.customer_id WHERE m.prev_arr IS NOT NULL), fy2025_movements AS (SELECT * FROM movements WHERE snapshot_month >= '2025-01-01' AND snapshot_month <= '2025-12-01'), opening AS (SELECT SUM(arr_usd) AS opening_arr FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month WHERE snapshot_month = '2024-12-01'), closing AS (SELECT SUM(arr_usd) AS closing_arr FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month WHERE snapshot_month = '2025-12-01') SELECT o.opening_arr, c.closing_arr, SUM(CASE WHEN fm.movement_type = 'new_logo' THEN fm.arr_movement ELSE 0 END) AS new_logo_arr, SUM(CASE WHEN fm.movement_type = 'expansion' THEN fm.arr_movement ELSE 0 END) AS expansion_arr, SUM(CASE WHEN fm.movement_type = 'contraction' THEN fm.arr_movement ELSE 0 END) AS contraction_arr, SUM(CASE WHEN fm.movement_type = 'churn' THEN fm.arr_movement ELSE 0 END) AS churned_arr, SUM(CASE WHEN fm.movement_type = 'reactivation' THEN fm.arr_movement ELSE 0 END) AS reactivation_arr FROM fy2025_movements fm CROSS JOIN opening o CROSS JOIN closing c GROUP BY o.opening_arr, c.closing_arr
metric_evidence.methodology: Monthly ARR movements classified using LAG window function. New logo distinguished from reactivation using customer_first_active CTE. Bridge reconciliation: Beginning + New Logo + Expansion + Contraction + Churn + Reactivation = Ending ARR. Reconciliation difference = ~0 (floating point).

metric_evidence.query: WITH opening_cohort AS (SELECT customer_id, arr_usd AS opening_arr FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month WHERE snapshot_month = '2024-12-01' AND arr_usd > 0), closing_arr AS (SELECT customer_id, arr_usd AS closing_arr FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month WHERE snapshot_month = '2025-12-01'), cohort_closing AS (SELECT oc.customer_id, oc.opening_arr, COALESCE(ca.closing_arr, 0) AS closing_arr FROM opening_cohort oc LEFT JOIN closing_arr ca ON oc.customer_id = ca.customer_id), grr_calc AS (SELECT customer_id, opening_arr, closing_arr, LEAST(closing_arr, opening_arr) AS retained_arr_capped FROM cohort_closing) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oc.customer_id) AS starting_cohort_count, SUM(oc.opening_arr) AS starting_arr, SUM(cc.closing_arr) AS ending_arr_cohort, SUM(cc.closing_arr) / SUM(oc.opening_arr) * 100 AS nrr_pct, SUM(gc.retained_arr_capped) AS retained_arr_grr, SUM(gc.retained_arr_capped) / SUM(oc.opening_arr) * 100 AS grr_pct FROM opening_cohort oc JOIN cohort_closing cc ON oc.customer_id = cc.customer_id JOIN grr_calc gc ON oc.customer_id = gc.customer_id
metric_evidence.methodology: NRR: ending ARR for opening cohort / opening cohort ARR. GRR: LEAST(closing_arr, opening_arr) per customer summed / opening cohort ARR (expansion excluded). Logo churn: cohort customers with zero closing ARR / total cohort count. Opening cohort = 2024-12-01 snapshot (immediately preceding FY2025 year-end).

metric_evidence.metric: Recurring revenue analysis FY2025 - management tagged and independently restated
metric_evidence.query: SELECT SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) AS total_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN fil.revenue_type = 'Recurring' THEN fil.line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS mgmt_recurring, SUM(CASE WHEN dp.delivery_model = 'Subscription' AND dp.product_family != 'Professional Services' THEN fil.line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS restated_recurring, SUM(CASE WHEN dp.product_family = 'Professional Services' THEN fil.line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS prof_services_rev, SUM(CASE WHEN dp.delivery_model = 'Perpetual' THEN fil.line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS perpetual_rev, SUM(CASE WHEN dp.delivery_model = 'One-time' THEN fil.line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS onetime_delivery_rev, SUM(CASE WHEN fil.revenue_type = 'Recurring' AND dp.delivery_model != 'Subscription' THEN fil.line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS recurring_tag_non_subscription, SUM(CASE WHEN dp.delivery_model = 'Subscription' AND dp.product_family != 'Professional Services' THEN fil.line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) / SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) * 100 AS restated_recurring_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN fil.revenue_type = 'Recurring' THEN fil.line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) / SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) * 100 AS mgmt_recurring_pct FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil ON fi.invoice_id = fil.invoice_id JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_product dp ON fil.product_id = dp.product_id WHERE YEAR(fi.invoice_date) = 2025
metric_evidence.methodology: Independent restatement uses delivery_model = 'Subscription' AND product_family != 'Professional Services' as economic substance criteria. Professional Services with One-time delivery model reclassified as non-recurring regardless of revenue_type tag. $4,675,078.45 reclassified from management-tagged recurring to independently non-recurring.

metric_evidence.metric: Quarterly DSO historical trend (Method A - direct invoice-level days_outstanding)
metric_evidence.query: SELECT YEAR(fi.invoice_date) AS yr, QUARTER(fi.invoice_date) AS qtr, CONCAT(YEAR(fi.invoice_date), '-Q', QUARTER(fi.invoice_date)) AS quarter_label, DATE_TRUNC('quarter', fi.invoice_date) AS period_start, LAST_DAY(ADD_MONTHS(DATE_TRUNC('quarter', fi.invoice_date), 2)) AS period_end, COUNT(fc.collection_id) AS invoice_count, AVG(fc.days_outstanding) AS avg_dso_days, MIN(fc.days_outstanding) AS min_days, MAX(fc.days_outstanding) AS max_days FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_collection fc JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi ON fc.invoice_id = fi.invoice_id GROUP BY YEAR(fi.invoice_date), QUARTER(fi.invoice_date), DATE_TRUNC('quarter', fi.invoice_date) ORDER BY yr, qtr
metric_evidence.methodology: Method A validated: days_outstanding in fact_collection exactly matches DATEDIFF(payment_date, invoice_date) for all validated records. Quarterly DSO = simple average of days_outstanding grouped by invoice quarter. Invoice_date used as period assignment basis consistent with revenue metrics.

metric_evidence.query: WITH fy2025_customer_rev AS (SELECT fi.customer_id, SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) AS customer_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) DESC) AS rev_rank FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil ON fi.invoice_id = fil.invoice_id WHERE YEAR(fi.invoice_date) = 2025 GROUP BY fi.customer_id), q4_2025_dso AS (SELECT fi.customer_id, AVG(fc.days_outstanding) AS avg_dso, COUNT(fc.collection_id) AS invoice_count FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_collection fc JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi ON fc.invoice_id = fi.invoice_id WHERE YEAR(fi.invoice_date) = 2025 AND QUARTER(fi.invoice_date) = 4 GROUP BY fi.customer_id), combined AS (SELECT r.customer_id, r.rev_rank, r.customer_revenue, d.avg_dso, d.invoice_count FROM fy2025_customer_rev r LEFT JOIN q4_2025_dso d ON r.customer_id = d.customer_id) SELECT 'Top 1' AS cohort, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customer_count, AVG(avg_dso) AS cohort_dso, SUM(customer_revenue) AS cohort_revenue FROM combined WHERE rev_rank <= 1 UNION ALL SELECT 'Top 3', COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id), AVG(avg_dso), SUM(customer_revenue) FROM combined WHERE rev_rank <= 3 UNION ALL SELECT 'Top 5', COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id), AVG(avg_dso), SUM(customer_revenue) FROM combined WHERE rev_rank <= 5 UNION ALL SELECT 'Remaining after Top 3', COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id), AVG(avg_dso), SUM(customer_revenue) FROM combined WHERE rev_rank > 3 UNION ALL SELECT 'Remaining after Top 5', COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id), AVG(avg_dso), SUM(customer_revenue) FROM combined WHERE rev_rank > 5 UNION ALL SELECT 'All Customers', COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id), AVG(avg_dso), SUM(customer_revenue) FROM combined
metric_evidence.methodology: Customers ranked by FY2025 total revenue. Top-N cohorts are cumulative. DSO calculated using same Method A (avg days_outstanding) for 2025-Q4 invoices. Top 3 (3 customers) + Remaining after Top 3 (195 customers) = 198 total. No overlap.

metric_evidence.query: SELECT dc.segment, COUNT(DISTINCT fi.customer_id) AS customer_count, AVG(fc.days_outstanding) AS avg_dso, COUNT(fc.collection_id) AS invoice_count FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_collection fc JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi ON fc.invoice_id = fi.invoice_id JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer dc ON fi.customer_id = dc.customer_id WHERE YEAR(fi.invoice_date) = 2025 AND QUARTER(fi.invoice_date) = 4 GROUP BY dc.segment ORDER BY avg_dso DESC
metric_evidence.methodology: DSO by segment using dim_customer.segment field. Same Method A applied. Segments: Enterprise, SMB, Mid-Market.

metric_evidence.metric: Weighted collection days by quarter (secondary metric)
metric_evidence.query: SELECT YEAR(fi.invoice_date) AS yr, QUARTER(fi.invoice_date) AS qtr, CONCAT(YEAR(fi.invoice_date), '-Q', QUARTER(fi.invoice_date)) AS quarter_label, SUM(fc.days_outstanding * fc.amount_paid_usd) / SUM(fc.amount_paid_usd) AS weighted_collection_days, SUM(fc.amount_paid_usd) AS total_paid, COUNT(fc.collection_id) AS invoice_count FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_collection fc JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi ON fc.invoice_id = fi.invoice_id GROUP BY YEAR(fi.invoice_date), QUARTER(fi.invoice_date) ORDER BY yr, qtr
metric_evidence.methodology: Amount-weighted average collection days: SUM(days_outstanding * amount_paid_usd) / SUM(amount_paid_usd). Secondary metric only; not equivalent to primary DSO series.

metric_evidence.metric: Customer tenure - Top 10 by FY2025 revenue
metric_evidence.query: WITH fy2025_rev AS (SELECT fi.customer_id, SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) AS customer_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) DESC) AS rev_rank FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil ON fi.invoice_id = fil.invoice_id WHERE YEAR(fi.invoice_date) = 2025 GROUP BY fi.customer_id), top10 AS (SELECT r.customer_id, dc.first_order_date FROM fy2025_rev r JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer dc ON r.customer_id = dc.customer_id WHERE r.rev_rank <= 10) SELECT COUNT(*) AS top10_count, AVG(DATEDIFF('2025-12-31', first_order_date) / 365.25) AS avg_tenure_years, MIN(DATEDIFF('2025-12-31', first_order_date) / 365.25) AS min_tenure_years, MAX(DATEDIFF('2025-12-31', first_order_date) / 365.25) AS max_tenure_years FROM top10
metric_evidence.methodology: Tenure = DATEDIFF('2025-12-31', first_order_date) / 365.25. Average calculated in SQL. Top 10 customers ranked by FY2025 invoice-date revenue.

metric_evidence.metric: Customer health - support ticket trends for top 5 customers and overall
metric_evidence.query: WITH fy2025_rev AS (SELECT fi.customer_id, SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) AS customer_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) DESC) AS rev_rank FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil ON fi.invoice_id = fil.invoice_id WHERE YEAR(fi.invoice_date) = 2025 GROUP BY fi.customer_id), top5 AS (SELECT customer_id FROM fy2025_rev WHERE rev_rank <= 5), ticket_metrics AS (SELECT st.customer_id, YEAR(st.opened_date) AS yr, COUNT(st.ticket_id) AS total_tickets, SUM(CASE WHEN st.severity IN ('High','Critical') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_sev_tickets, AVG(st.csat_score) AS avg_csat, AVG(st.resolution_hours) AS avg_resolution_hours FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_support_ticket st WHERE st.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM top5) GROUP BY st.customer_id, YEAR(st.opened_date)) SELECT tm.customer_id, dc.customer_name, tm.yr, tm.total_tickets, tm.high_sev_tickets, tm.avg_csat, tm.avg_resolution_hours FROM ticket_metrics tm JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer dc ON tm.customer_id = dc.customer_id ORDER BY tm.customer_id, tm.yr
metric_evidence.methodology: Top 5 customers selected dynamically from FY2025 revenue ranking. Support metrics aggregated by year. CSAT change and ticket volume change calculated in SQL.

metric_evidence.query: SELECT YEAR(contract_end_date) AS expiry_year, COUNT(*) AS contract_count, SUM(acv_usd) AS total_acv, MIN(contract_end_date) AS earliest_end, MAX(contract_end_date) AS latest_end FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_contract WHERE status = 'Active' GROUP BY YEAR(contract_end_date) ORDER BY expiry_year
metric_evidence.methodology: Active contracts grouped by expiry year. No authoritative close date available; renewal exposure window not calculated. Distribution provided for reference only.

metric_evidence.query: WITH outstanding_invoices AS (SELECT fi.customer_id, fi.invoice_amount_usd - COALESCE(fc.amount_paid_usd, 0) AS outstanding_balance FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_collection fc ON fi.invoice_id = fc.invoice_id WHERE COALESCE(fc.status, 'Outstanding') = 'Outstanding' AND fi.invoice_amount_usd - COALESCE(fc.amount_paid_usd, 0) > 0), customer_ar AS (SELECT customer_id, SUM(outstanding_balance) AS ar_balance FROM outstanding_invoices GROUP BY customer_id), total_ar AS (SELECT SUM(ar_balance) AS total FROM customer_ar), ranked AS (SELECT customer_id, ar_balance, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ar_balance DESC) AS ar_rank FROM customer_ar) SELECT t.total AS total_outstanding_ar, SUM(CASE WHEN r.ar_rank = 1 THEN r.ar_balance ELSE 0 END) AS top1_ar, SUM(CASE WHEN r.ar_rank <= 3 THEN r.ar_balance ELSE 0 END) AS top3_ar, SUM(CASE WHEN r.ar_rank <= 5 THEN r.ar_balance ELSE 0 END) AS top5_ar, SUM(CASE WHEN r.ar_rank > 5 THEN r.ar_balance ELSE 0 END) AS remaining_ar, SUM(CASE WHEN r.ar_rank = 1 THEN r.ar_balance ELSE 0 END) / t.total * 100 AS top1_ar_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN r.ar_rank <= 3 THEN r.ar_balance ELSE 0 END) / t.total * 100 AS top3_ar_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN r.ar_rank <= 5 THEN r.ar_balance ELSE 0 END) / t.total * 100 AS top5_ar_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN r.ar_rank > 5 THEN r.ar_balance ELSE 0 END) / t.total * 100 AS remaining_ar_pct FROM ranked r CROSS JOIN total_ar t GROUP BY t.total
metric_evidence.methodology: Outstanding AR reconstructed from fact_invoice minus fact_collection payments. AR aging uses DATEDIFF from invoice_date to 2025-12-31. AR concentration ranked by customer outstanding balance.

issues.description: fact_collection.days_outstanding for 96 Outstanding (unpaid) invoices is not applicable as no payment_date exists. These invoices are excluded from the settled-invoice average DSO series but are fully captured in outstanding AR balance ($6,236,836.60) and AR aging analysis.
issues.resolution: Outstanding invoices captured separately in AR balance and aging. DSO series reflects settled invoice collection cycle only.
